text:
braden: Flying into BOS tomorrow morning, landing near Back Bay. Need quick breakfast recs for 4 ppl before a 9am meeting.
isla: Tatte has great pastries but lines form early.
pete: Bagelsaurus is solid for bagel sandwiches and moves fast.
anya: Flour Bakery is reliable and has GF options.
breakfast-bot: Tip: if you want sit-down, book ahead; most places do counter service.
braden: I need something that can seat 4 or do quick takeout for the office.
isla: If you want quick + cheap, eat at the counter at Bagelsaurus or pick up from Clover Food Lab truck (seasonal).
pete: Tatte could work if you order ahead online for pickup.
anya: Also, Thinking Cup on Dartmouth has decent coffee and a few pastry options, smaller but cozy.
braden: Any vegan/egg-free recs?
isla: Flour has good vegan muffins sometimes. Clover does vegan bowls.
anya: Bagelsaurus can do avocado + tomato on a plain bagel, not fully vegan but close.
braden: Poll: react with emoji: :bagel: Bagelsaurus, :croissant: Tatte, :apple: Flour, :coffee: Thinking Cup/Clover.
breakfast-bot: Poll created  react to vote.
isla: :croissant:
pete: :bagel:
anya: :apple:
braden: :croissant: (leaning pastries + coffee)
breakfast-bot: Current tally: Tatte 2, Bagelsaurus 1, Flour 1, Clover 0. Reminder set for Mon 7:15am "Braden Back Bay breakfast decision".
isla: If Tatte wins I'll order via their app and pick up. Less lines then.
braden: Perfect. Will confirm final plan in AM. Thanks!
